as_told.title: Iranian pilot fires at a UAP and goes down

plain: In 1976 an Iranian pilot named Parviz Jafari had a dramatic run-in with a UFO while flying an F-4 Phantom fighter jet over Tehran, says the documentary filmmaker James Fox, who tells Michels he met Jafari himself. Fox thinks it happened around 1975, and he mentions an assessment of the incident by the Defense Intelligence Agency, the Pentagon's military intelligence arm. In a later episode Michels retells Fox's version without naming the pilot, dates it to about 1979, and says the pilot fired at the object. If true, it would be a military pilot trying to engage an unknown craft.
